decision: Isolate CPU-bound/synchronous/non-cooperative attempts in a separate execution context (worker_thread or child process). Async-I/O model calls may stay in-process and remain cooperatively cancellable (GAP-MODEL-ABORT-01). Front/dispatcher never runs a synchronous heavy attempt.
note: worker_thread demonstrates the event-loop protection cheaply; media/subprocess/browser attempts additionally need a killable OS process (child_process + TERM/grace/KILL) for GAP-MODEL-ABORT-style non-cooperative cancel.
